title: Conditions Governing Refund Form and Future Travel Credit, Vacation Package Products
content:
These conditions state, for each of the Vacation Package Products, the form value is returned in on cancellation, the business days the settlement of an approved refund takes, the calendar months a future travel credit stays redeemable from its issue date, and whether a future travel credit may be redeemed by another traveller.

**1. Form of return.** Value is returned in the form the product booked publishes, and in that form alone: money to the original form of payment, a future travel credit voucher, or nothing returned.

**2. Settlement time.** The settlement of an approved refund takes the number of business days published for the product booked.

**3. Credit validity.** A future travel credit stays redeemable for the number of calendar months published for the product that produced it, counted from its issue date.

**4. Transfer of a credit.** A future travel credit may be redeemed by a traveller other than the one it was issued to only on a product published as making credits transferable.

| Product | Form value is returned in | Settlement time | Credit validity | Credit redeemable by another traveller |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | nothing is returned | 0 business days | 0 calendar months | not transferable |
| Flex Bundle Package | the original form of payment | 21 business days | 12 calendar months | not transferable |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | a future travel credit voucher | 21 business days | 18 calendar months | transferable |
| Escorted Tour Package | a future travel credit voucher | 28 business days | 18 calendar months | transferable |
| Ocean Cruise Package | a future travel credit voucher | 35 business days | 24 calendar months | transferable |
| Luxury Collection Package | the original form of payment | 14 business days | 24 calendar months | transferable |

**5. Reading the entries together.** The Value Bundle Package returns nothing at all, and its settlement and validity figures accordingly stand at nil. Two products return money to the original form of payment, the Flex Bundle Package in 21 business days and the Luxury Collection Package in 14. Three return a voucher, and each of those three makes its vouchers transferable, the validity running from 18 calendar months on the All-Inclusive Resort Package and the Escorted Tour Package to 24 on the Ocean Cruise Package.
